## 1. Trend: bursty, not a steady increase

Sonnet 5 (`us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5`) accounts for about 18.07M of roughly 18.6M logged output tokens, about 97%. All other models are small. Opus 4.8 produced 144k output tokens and GPT-5.6-terra about 350k. Nova Lite produced about 60k.
